prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic Mediterranean luxury-resort pool portrait with bright natural daylight and warm summer atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with light sun-kissed skin, a messy high bun, loose face-framing strands, small rectangular sunglasses, natural summer makeup, and a calm confident expression. She wears a black one-piece swimsuit with cream detail and an oversized white shirt worn open.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing near a turquoise pool edge, centered in a vertical medium-full-body frame from head to upper thighs, one leg slightly forward, left hand holding shirt edge and right hand holding the pool ladder. Show loungers, white umbrellas, stone tiles, large green pine trees, and terrace railing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High midday sun with soft natural shadows, bright warm summer mood, clean natural tones, realistic skin and matte swim fabric.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, slightly low angle with eye-level torso focus, sharp subject and softly softened background, vertical portrait, high-resolution photorealism.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic Mediterranean luxury-resort pool portrait of an adult blonde woman with light sun-kissed skin, a messy high bun with loose strands, small rectangular dark sunglasses, natural summer makeup, and a calm confident expression. She wears a black one-piece swimsuit with cream/ivory bust detail and an oversized white cotton shirt worn open, standing upright near a clear turquoise pool edge with one leg slightly forward, left hand holding the shirt edge and right hand holding the pool ladder. Include sun loungers, white umbrellas, stone tiles, large green pine trees, and terrace railing. Bright high midday natural daylight, soft shadows, slightly low 35mm angle, medium-full-body vertical framing from head to upper thighs, sharp subject, slightly softened background, warm summer atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, cartoon, anime, illustration, overexposed, blurry, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, watermark
